integrity: Two independently written verification programs ran successfully; they prove exact polynomial identities and corroborate finite-field counts, respectively. Proof over the algebraic closure is mathematical and does not rely on finite extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Classification is of coefficient-marked smooth genus-four members over the algebraic closure of F7; no classification by geometric isomorphism, full Ekedahl-Oort type or Newton polygon is asserted. The 2025 Sohn paper is a plausible priority-overlap risk for a-number claims, with full text inaccessible. Exact stable-rank classification is distinguished from general Cartier methods.
title: A 24-point 7-rank-one stratum in a bielliptic cyclic trigonal family of genus four
